title: Research candidate
description: One evaluated data-source candidate from the research-sources procedure (.claude/skills/research-sources/SKILL.md). One file per candidate at research/candidates/<slug>.json.

url.description: Primary docs/landing page for the dataset.

gap.description: The stated gap this candidate was evaluated against.

coverage.description: Geographic scope, e.g. national, NYC-only, specific states.

granularity.description: Finest geographic unit available, e.g. census tract, block group, county, CBSA, national single series.

history.description: How far back the series/dataset goes.

license.description: License/ToS summary: attribution requirements, redistribution limits, copyright holder if not the publishing agency.

cost.description: Confirmation it is actually free, and any rate limit.

access.description: no_key_no_login: open download/API with no registration. free_key_no_login: free API key via self-serve signup, no approval/login wall. login_required: gated behind account approval/registration (disqualifying per CLAUDE.md). paid: not free.

correlation.description: Output of app/research/evaluate_series.py against FHFA tract HPI / Zillow ZORI, if that script exists and was run. Null with a reason if not computed.

recommendation.description: One-paragraph recommend / don't-recommend, with the key reason.
